exposure: methylation of four CpG sites in gene SLC9B1
cohort: 177 pregnant women, with a focus on 57 women aged 18-36 (mean 25.4) who had DNA methylation data available from their second prenatal visit (24-32 weeks gestation)
finding: The study found that fetal intolerance of labor could be accurately predicted from maternal blood samples obtained between 24-32 weeks gestation by assessing DNA methylation patterns of SLC9B1.
